claims.claim: Spotify's report combines squad ownership with chapters/guilds and describes an evolving 2012 snapshot.
Stine links autonomous delivery with platforms, automation and recovery.
Saha proposes builders, specialist enabling capabilities and a shared platform; effectiveness remains a hypothesis.
Context engineering curates the information available during model execution.
Agent evaluations distinguish cases, repeated trials, grading and final environment outcomes.
Containment constrains what an agent can do through environmental access controls.
Task selection and concurrent AI work can complicate productivity measurement.
Incomplete observations differ from measured completion times.
Small independently testable changes shorten feedback cycles.
Eight principles, ownership contracts, task contracts, maintenance and expansion sequence are handbook proposals.
claims.kind: author synthesis, not a documented guarantee

claims.claim: Six engineers, 48 assignments, $86,000 cap and all numerical gates/results are synthetic planning choices.
